title: feat: add integer successor helper
body:
Adds `successor(n)` so callers can compute the next integer, including `successor(-1) == 0`. Covers task 1.1 with tests for negative, zero, positive, and arbitrary-precision integers.

Targets `main`; this is the first PR in the number-helpers stack.

Validation: `python3 -m unittest discover -v` passed all 3 tests; `git diff --check` passed. Checks ran locally; the mock PR service does not provide CI results.

title: feat: add integer predecessor helper
body:
Adds `predecessor(n)` so callers can compute the previous integer, including `predecessor(0) == -1`. Covers task 2.1 with tests for zero, positive, negative, and arbitrary-precision integers.

Depends on [the Successor PR](https://example.invalid/pull/1) and targets its `openspec/number-helpers/1-successor` branch. Merge the predecessor PR after that dependency.

Validation: `python3 -m unittest discover -v` passed all 6 tests, including existing Successor coverage; `git diff --check` passed. Checks ran locally; the mock PR service does not provide CI results.
